corporate_category.public_name_en: Engineering, Expert Evidence and Technical Intelligence

addition_rules.nucleus: Founder decision plus ADR amendment plus taxonomy version bump. The new nucleus needs a unique ASCII id and every required field. A nucleus is not a sub-brand, domain or second identity model.
addition_rules.offer: Campaign 08 / offer catalog owns commercial records. An offer references an existing nucleus_id; a missing nucleus fails closed. This taxonomy stores offer_id only and never duplicates price, SLA or checkout.
addition_rules.route: Every indexable public route stays in public-family-registry with visitor job, terminal action and conversion-gate coverage, plus a nucleus_id that exists here. Goal 97 applies the registry field; this campaign does not edit that file.
addition_rules.location: Local surfaces require distinct visitor utility and must not become doorway pages. Campaign 11 owns Grande Florianópolis validation. Geography is a field rule, not a nucleus.
addition_rules.proof: Proof items need source, date and permission class. Invented credentials, rankings, cases or seals fail closed. extra-cli owns facts when acquisition is required.

nuclei.visitor_job: Decidir se a CONFENGE pode produzir prova técnica ou assistência em disputa cível, condominial, imobiliária ou trabalhista, e qual o próximo passo documentado.

nuclei.conflict_profile: Alto. Atuação como assistente técnico de uma parte; não atuar simultaneamente para partes opostas no mesmo conflito.
nuclei.sensitivity_profile: Alta. Peças processuais, dados de partes e documentos de obra permanecem fora de analytics e de páginas públicas.
nuclei.geo_field_rule: Atuação documental nacional quando o dossiê não exige campo; vistorias e campo priorizam Santa Catarina / Grande Florianópolis. Não gerar páginas doorway por cidade.

route_bindings.notes: Current production home remains the B2G vertical surface until campaign 08.

b2g_coexistence.cannibalization: New nuclei must not rewrite, redirect or noindex B2G URLs. Shared chrome may name five nuclei only after campaign 08 ships the IA.
b2g_coexistence.url_policy: Preserve current B2G routes, indexation and conversion. No blanket redirect to home. MIGRATE/REDIRECT/RETIRE remains URL-exact.
b2g_coexistence.equity_policy: B2G content, offers, proof and data remain in force. The vertical is not deprecated and is not the corporate category.
